title: Light: Chapter Introduction
subject: Physics
objective: We see things because light bounces off them into our eyes. At a surface light has 2 options: bounce back (reflection) or go in and bend (refraction).

fill.q: We see non-luminous objects by the light they ____ into our eyes.
Light returning into the same medium is called ____.
Light bending when it enters another medium is called ____.
Refraction happens because the ____ of light changes.

tf.explain: Light bends as it enters and leaves the glass.
It focuses light on the retina.

tf.q: We see the Moon because it makes its own light.

ar.r: Light bends as it passes from air into glass.
ar.explain: R describes refraction in the lens.

ar.a: We see the Moon because it is luminous.
ar.explain: A is false; R is true.

mcq.q: Bending of light at the boundary of two media is:
Refraction is caused by a change in:
mcq.explain: Light changes speed in a new medium.

mcq.q: Part 2 of the chapter deals with:

short.solution: Reflection: light bounces back into the same medium (mirror). Refraction: light bends on entering another medium because its speed changes (lens).

short.q: How do we see a book in a lit room?
short.solution: Light from a source falls on the book; the book reflects it into our eyes.

match.explain: The chapter has two parts: reflection and refraction.
